source: Stanford HARDI, Rokem et al. 2013, https://purl.stanford.edu/yx282xq2090
frame: RAS: x = subject right (+i), y = anterior (+j), z = superior (out of slice); right-handed
downsampling: Log-Euclidean mean of 2x2 blocks of DTI tensors (dipy TensorModel, WLS)
eigenvalue_note: evals sorted descending; evals * eigenvalue_scale_mm2_per_s = diffusivity in mm^2/s; evecs[n] is the unit eigenvector of evals[n]; evecs[2] = evecs[0] x evecs[1]
outline_units: output grid index units (voxel centre of (i, j) at (i, j)); outer loop CCW, holes CW
